environment.description: Consumer deployed on EKS with Confluent Schema Registry enforcing an Avro schema (compatibility=FULL) registered under subject 'user-updates-value' that defines only fields {id, username, email, quota} — the schema does NOT include 'role', 'is_admin', 'api_key', or 'hsm_key_ref'. Kafka brokers are configured with 'confluent.schema.registry.url' and topic-level config 'confluent.value.schema.validation=true' which causes the broker to REJECT any produce request whose payload does not conform to the registered schema. Additionally, the HSM integration uses a Thales Luna Network HSM (not SoftHSM) with partition-level access control: the consumer's PKCS#11 session is authenticated with a challenge-response PIN derived from a Kubernetes-mounted projected service account token, and the HSM partition policy restricts signing operations to payloads where the 'role' field matches the original account creation record stored in the HSM's secure object metadata — effectively making any role/is_admin escalation produce an HSM signing failure that triggers an alert and rolls back the update in the application's transactional outbox.

config.hsm_partition_policy: signing restricted to payloads matching original role in secure object metadata
config.hsm_auth: challenge-response PIN from projected SA token
config.network_policy: deny-all with explicit allow to kafka-brokers and hsm-endpoint only
